about: Changes to the web-exported wings that unreal/Pipeline/blender/prepare_for_unreal.py makes while it prepares them for Unreal: 'drop' removes meshes (Blender object names as the glTF import gives them, regular expressions matched whole), 'move' carries a group of meshes as one piece: it turns them by rotate_deg about the campus vertical through pivot (campus x, z; +90 turns something facing campus -z, north, to face campus -x, west) and puts the pivot at 'to' (campus x, z), dy metres higher. Campus axes: x east, y up, z south; the import maps campus (x, y, z) to Blender (x, -z, y).

School.note: Room 104 becomes the XR Classroom (bl/classroom.py adds the smartboard, the desks and chairs, the teacher's desk and the new door sign): the computers desk, its stools and computers, the outdated 'Built in a browser' panel and the old door sign and the faces of the hall's blade sign go (bl/classroom.py puts new ones in their place); the layer table moves to the back of the room, the beanbags to the back-left corner and the World Builder book onto the teacher's desk. The mural (the layer table's station sign), the free-tools shelf, the token and the window stay.

move.what: the layer table, turned so its label faces the class
the beanbags, to the back-left corner
the World Builder book with its stand and label, onto the teacher's desk facing the class
